answer: The copper edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 113 clones produces a signature the ridge analysis flags immediately. Someone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the ledge settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
